review_text: This wireless mouse is super comfortable and the battery lasts forever.
Tracking is a bit jumpy on glass surfaces, not what I expected.
Solid budget mouse, does exactly what it says.
The mechanical keyboard feels amazing to type on, worth every penny.
Way too loud for an open office, my coworkers complained.
Great build quality but the software for remapping keys is clunky.
This USB-C hub finally let me use two monitors without lag.
One of the ports stopped working after two weeks of light use.
Compact, cool to the touch, and transfers files quickly.
Video quality on this webcam is crisp even in low light.
Autofocus hunts constantly during video calls, pretty distracting.
Good value webcam, easy plug and play setup on my laptop.

Lightweight, folds flat for travel, exactly what I needed.
